name: @oge-ui/react-gantt
description: React Gantt chart from the OGE UI suite: a virtualized task tree pane and a timeline chart with summary brackets, milestone diamonds, baseline bars, FS/SS/FF/SF dependency arrows, critical path, forward auto-scheduling on work calendars, resource labels and a workload band, drag move/resize/progress with Escape-cancel, link drawing with cycle rejection, snapshot undo/redo, keyboard bar editing, a built-in context menu and task dialog, and Excel/PDF/PNG export — running the same framework-free Gantt engine and the same stylesheet as the Angular package. Source-available commercial license (free for evaluation and development).
author: kaya2m
